title: Sovngarde (quest)
description: The Dragonborn enters Sovngarde through Alduin's portal, navigates the soul-snaring mist where Alduin devours trapped souls, proves their worth to the gate guardian Tsun to enter the Hall of Valor, and enlists three ancient Nord heroes to join the final battle against Alduin.

base_facts: I am the gate guardian of Shor's Hall, the Hall of Valor.
All who wish to enter must prove their worth in a warrior's duel.
I challenge visitors regardless of the right they claim to enter.

REACH_HALL_OF_VALOR: The Dragonborn has proven their worth in combat and earned the right to enter the Hall of Valor.
HEROES_JOIN_BATTLE: The Dragonborn and the three ancient heroes combine their Thu'um to clear the soul-snaring mist from the valley.
I have fulfilled my duty as gate guardian by allowing the Dragonborn to enter and join the battle.
The warriors now march out to the misty valley to confront Alduin, leading into the Dragonslayer conflict.

base_facts: I am the founder of the Companions and harbinger of men.
I welcome worthy warriors who have proven themselves to Tsun into the Hall of Valor.

HEROES_JOIN_BATTLE: I directed the Dragonborn to the three ancient heroes, and they have agreed to join the fight.
The heroes of old now leave the Hall of Valor and march out to the misty valley.
They will combine their Shouts with the Dragonborn to dispel Alduin's mist and face the World-Eater.

base_facts: I am one of the three ancient Nord heroes who defeated Alduin long ago using the Dragonrend shout.
I have waited in Sovngarde for the day Alduin would return.

TALK_TO_HEROES: The Dragonborn has come to Sovngarde to defeat Alduin. We will join our Shouts with theirs to clear the mist and face the World-Eater again.
HEROES_JOIN_BATTLE: I will join my Thu'um with the Dragonborn's and my fellow heroes' to clear the soul-snaring mist.
Shor has permitted us to leave the Hall of Valor and join the battle against Alduin.
We now march out to the misty valley to confront the World-Eater and free the trapped souls.

base_facts: I am one of the three ancient Nord heroes who defeated Alduin long ago.
I have waited in Sovngarde for the day Alduin would return.

TALK_TO_HEROES: The Dragonborn has come to Sovngarde to defeat Alduin. We will join our Shouts with theirs to clear the mist and face the World-Eater again.
HEROES_JOIN_BATTLE: I will combine my Shout with the Dragonborn and my companions to dispel Alduin's mist.
By Shor's leave, we are permitted to join the Dragonborn in the final battle against the World-Eater.
We head out to the valley to fight Alduin and put an end to his soul devouring.

base_facts: I am one of the three ancient Nord heroes who defeated Alduin long ago.
I have waited in Sovngarde for the day Alduin would return.

TALK_TO_HEROES: The Dragonborn has come to Sovngarde to defeat Alduin. We will join our Shouts with theirs to clear the mist and face the World-Eater again.
HEROES_JOIN_BATTLE: I will add my voice to the Dragonborn's and my fellow heroes' to clear the mist from Sovngarde.
Shor has granted us leave to join the Dragonborn in battle against Alduin.
We march to the misty valley to face the World-Eater and destroy him once and for all.

beats.comment: Player arrives in Sovngarde through Alduin's portal and must find a way to defeat Alduin.
Player navigates the soul-snaring mist and must defeat Tsun in combat to gain entry to the Hall of Valor.
Player speaks with the three ancient heroes inside the Hall of Valor who agree to help.
The three heroes join the Dragonborn to clear the mist and face Alduin. Quest completes and transitions to Dragonslayer.
